description: This Java class 'LogView' is a custom Android widget extending TextView, implementing the LogNode interface to display log messages received from the logging system. It formats log entries with priority, tag, message, and exception details, then outputs them to the UI, optionally forwarding to a chained LogNode.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs formatted log data received through the LogNode interface. It handles different log levels, formats output, and interacts with the UI thread to display logs.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and appends a log message to the LogView, including handling throwable exceptions and ensuring thread-safe UI updates. Also forwards the log message to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Utility method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
